07_size_increase_loses_priority

Shadow bid 10 @ 5000.00 behind o1 (60) and o2 (40); o3 (30) behind. o1 modifies its size up to 70 and goes to the back of the level. A trade of 45 fills o2 (40) and o3 (5): the exact engine fills the shadow 5. A simulator that keeps o1's priority on a size increase keeps 100 ahead and does not fill.
